app.title: Elena — Road to the BFA
app.tagline: Every deadline, audition, and requirement in one place.

nyc.label: New York City area
nyc.note: Four schools audition in/around NYC (Jan-Mar). One or two well-timed trips can cover several. Purchase is Westchester, ~35 min from Grand Central.

socal.label: Southern California
socal.note: USC (LA), LMU (Westchester, ~12 mi from USC) and Chapman (Orange, ~40 mi) are combinable into one Southern California trip. LMU's audition is video-only, so it needs no travel of its own.

boston.label: Boston
boston.note: Boston Conservatory offers a live-online audition — may avoid the flight.

tucson.label: Tucson, AZ
tucson.note: Video-only audition accepted, but an in-person Sept/Jan date (before ~Feb 1) preserves first-year Dance Merit talent aid.

lastRefresh.summary: Re-verified all 9 schools against live sources. NYU Tisch's application-requirements and FAQ pages were reachable this session and yielded new callback-notification dates and per-session callback times/locations. Flagged a pendingChange at Pace: the Sands pre-screen deadline now reads Jan 4, 2027 on the Key Dates page, one day later than the stored confirmed_2027 Jan 3 value — not overwritten, awaiting a human check. Other new finds: LMU's solo video can be replaced with a "Pre-Approval" verification; Boston Conservatory's live-online audition is confirmed NOT a pre-screen (a true pre-recorded audition is offered only by exception); USC Kaufman's portfolio page no longer restates its Dec 1 deadline text (value held, flagged for a SlideRoom spot-check); Fordham/Ailey's photo spec now also names the required attire. All other previously confirmed_2027 facts across Arizona, Chapman, SUNY Purchase, and Pace were reconfirmed unchanged. Fordham's general admissions pages (fordham.edu) remain CAS-gated and unreachable.
